name: Threadbare
source:
Threadbare is a visual novel that explores the complex story of Anya, a protagonist trapped in a web of negative perceptions. Navigate a surreal world filled with exaggerated metaphors and intimidating scenery as you experience Anya's delusional point of view. Through this journey of self-discovery, you'll uncover the intricacies of her fragmented psyche and face the challenges that shape her reality.

[From [url=https://regah-productions.itch.io/threadbare]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Threadbare》是一部视觉小说，探讨了主角安雅 (Anya) 的复杂故事，主角被困在负面认知的网络中。当你体验安雅的妄想观点时，你将在一个充满夸张隐喻和令人生畏的风景的超现实世界中遨游。通过这段自我发现之旅，你将揭开她支离破碎的心灵的错综复杂，并面对塑造她现实的挑战。

[来自[url=https://regah-productions.itch.io/threadbare]itch.io[/url]]
